messages:
Sam: Noticed increased mTLS handshake failures from ap-south->eu-west since 09:10 UTC. Proxy logs show 'handshake alert 40' and 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority'.
Iris: Any IAM/KMS pushes recently?
Sam: Yes — infra/iam#1583 removed arn:aws:iam::666:role/egress-proxy-decrypt from CMK alias/ephemeral-keystores as part of cleanup.
Iris: @kms-bot, fetch decrypt::Denied for alias/ephemeral-keystores 09:05-09:15 UTC
kms-bot: 09:07:12 decrypt::Denied principal=arn:aws:iam::666:role/egress-proxy-decrypt reason=NotFoundInPolicy req=fff-101
kms-bot: 09:08:30 decrypt::Denied principal=arn:aws:iam::666:role/egress-proxy-decrypt reason=NotFoundInPolicy req=fff-102
Sam: I reverted infra/iam#1584 at 09:09:45 and re-added the principal.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-9345 created and alert noise muted 20m.
Iris: Mitigations: revert (done), enable proxy cert-cache fallback 15m, add alert rule for >5 decrypt::Denied in 5m.
Sam: Follow-ups: SEC-5701 (RCA), IAM-340 (2-approver gating), INFRA-935 (staging unwrap smoke test + pre-merge safety script).
Iris: Also add a PR checklist entry: "Does this change touch CMK principals?" and require staging smoke run. Closing thread.
